ruleDefinitions.name: Python Spawning Pretty TTY Via PTY Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a python process calling to the PTY module in order to spawn a pretty tty which could be indicative of potential reverse shell activity.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\/python$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/python2$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/python3$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\/python2\\\..*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\/python3\\\..*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*import\\ pty.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*from\\ pty\\ .*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*spawn.*"))
